description: Change of use from Use Class C3 (dwelling house) to Use Class C4 (HMO-house in multiple occupation) for six persons including single-storey infill extension, rear dormer, front roof lights and provision of refuse and cycle storage.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans with the approved plans which forms part of this notice.  Location Plan; Block Plan; Highway impact assessment; SuDS proforma; P00; P01 (dated 05.06.2026); P02; P03; P04; P05; P06; P07.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

No independent cooking or laundry facilities shall be installed in any of the respective bedrooms, and the kitchen/dining room  and shall be retained as such, in accordance with the approved plans, in perpetuity.Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

Notwithstanding the submitted plans, prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, revised details of cycle parking must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The cycle parking must be provided in compliance with the following criteria:o	Provision of a minimum of SIX long stay cycle parking spaceso	in an accessible location: the access route to the store should be a minimum of 1.2m wide to enable the bike to enter the store, should be step free and involve no more than 2 doors or gates (excluding the store door) which must also have a minimum opening width of 1.2m. This could include relocation of the cycle store to the front of the dwelling if practicable or the addition of a gate to the rear to allow direct access to Goldsdown Road.o	secured: with a British Standard mortice lock or access fobo	fully enclosed: 4 walls and a roofReason: The Council's Climate Action and Transport Policies seek to increase the use of active and sustainable transport modes. This means that access to bicycle parking should be easy and secure to remove potential barriers to cycling.

Prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, the refuse and recycling storage hereby approved shall be provided in accordance with the approved details and thereafter maintained unless otherwise submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: In the interests of amenity and the recycling of waste materials in support of the Boroughs waste reduction targets.

The use of the property as a House in Multiple Occupation hereby approved shall be occupied by a maximum of 6 people at any one time and shall not be subdivided or occupied as self-contained units. Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those specified in the approved application.  Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
